subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Heist and Con Artist Genre
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Heist and Con Artist Genre.

hook.text: In Money Heist, the criminals are the heroes. Audiences cheered as thieves robbed the Royal Mint of Spain.

buildup.text: Heist shows flip the crime formula. Instead of catching criminals, viewers plan with them and root for the score.

discovery.text: The genre thrives on clever twists. Every plan has a complication. Every complication has a hidden backup plan.

twist.text: Audiences love heist shows because stealing from the powerful feels like justice—even when it's clearly a crime.

climax.text: From Lupin to Leverage, the heist genre turns theft into a spectator sport where brains always beat brawn.

punchline.text: We root for thieves when the victims are rich enough.

quiz.question: What makes heist shows different from typical crime procedurals?
options: Viewers root for the criminals planning the heist
